tasks.label: Check account config visibility
args: const fs=require("fs");const s=fs.existsSync("backend/.env")?fs.readFileSync("backend/.env","utf8"):"";for(const k of ["VERIFY_REQUESTER_EMAIL","VERIFY_REQUESTER_PASSWORD","VERIFY_TECHNICIAN_EMAIL","VERIFY_TECHNICIAN_PASSWORD","VERIFY_ADMIN_EMAIL","VERIFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD"]){const m=s.match(new RegExp("^\\s*"+k+"\\s*=\\s*(.*)$","m"));const v=m&&m[1].trim();console.log(k+": "+(!m?"unset":!v?"empty":/^your_/i.test(v)?"placeholder":"present"))}

tasks.label: Verify production login API routing
args: const assert=require('node:assert/strict'),fs=require('node:fs'),vm=require('node:vm');const source=fs.readFileSync('frontend/assets/js/api-config.js','utf8');new vm.Script(source);(async()=>{for(const hostname of ['simms-mau.netlify.app','simms-ict-maintenance-system.netlify.app']){let outgoing;const window={location:{protocol:'https:',hostname,origin:'https://'+hostname,href:'https://'+hostname+'/views/login.html'},fetch:(url,init)=>{outgoing={url,headers:init.headers};return Promise.resolve({status:200})}};const document={body:{},head:{appendChild(){}},createElement:()=>({}),querySelector:()=>({})};const context={window,document,localStorage:{getItem:()=> 'test-token'},URL,Headers,Request,console,setTimeout,clearTimeout};vm.runInNewContext(source,context);assert.equal(context.API_BASE,'https://dbu-ict-maintenance-service.onrender.com/api');await window.fetch(context.API_BASE+'/auth/me');assert.equal(outgoing.url,'https://dbu-ict-maintenance-service.onrender.com/api/auth/me');assert.equal(outgoing.headers.get('Authorization'),'Bearer test-token')}console.log('PASS: production API URL, syntax, and bearer token for both Netlify hostnames')})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1})
